name: scroll-area
title: Scroll Area
description: Bounded native scroll container with keyboard access.

files.content:
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "react";

export function ScrollArea({ className = "", tabIndex = 0, ...props }: HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>) { return <div tabIndex={tabIndex} className={`co-relative co-overflow-auto co-rounded-md focus-visible:co-ring-2 ${className}`.trim()} {...props} />; }

meta.accessibility: Uses semantic HTML, preserves keyboard operation, exposes visible focus, and keeps accessible naming under consumer control.
